matched_conditions: candidate frozen before episode-2 external return
no candidate access to baseline or candidate episode-2 return
returned_metrics: distinct study-anchor coverage across admitted sources
mean relevance matches per admitted source
decision_rule: PASS_BOUNDED_RELATION_TRACE_QUERY_V2 only if candidate preserves or improves anchor coverage, mean relevance matches, external-center count, and token budget relative to lexical baseline, while strictly improving at least one. Any regression on these declared dimensions WITHHOLDs.
internalization_rule: V2 query gain remains insufficient for B3. Internalization additionally requires capability-specific scaffold/source removal where applicable, restart/rehydration, delayed reuse, fresh disjoint transfer, decoy/shortcut controls, and independent or evaluator-hidden return.
claim_fence: A pass shows only bounded returned query-relevance improvement over the frozen lexical reconstruction. It does not establish general semantics, general memory learning, WWW truth, AGI, consciousness, or promotion.

burden_scope.B1_ABSTRACTION: requires bounded nuisance-invariance probe before returned comparator may count as B1 evidence
burden_scope.B2_CAUSAL_USE: returned baseline-vs-candidate consequence may count only as bounded downstream causal comparison after B1 probe passes
burden_scope.B3_INTERNALIZATION: explicitly out of scope; requires later source removal, restart/delayed reuse, fresh disjoint transfer, and independent/evaluator-hidden return

required_b1_probes: source-order permutation must preserve trace signature
opaque source-identity renaming plus irrelevant metadata must preserve trace signature
removing relevant anchor incidence must change or WITHHOLD the trace

trigger_evidence.observation: v0.1 passed candidate despite external-center count falling from 6 to 3 because lexicographic anchor coverage dominated diversity

required_nonregression: candidate mean relevance matches >= lexical baseline
candidate external center count >= lexical baseline
candidate query token count <= lexical baseline
strict_gain_requirement: at least one declared metric strictly improves after all non-regression checks pass
known_limitations: anchor/relevance matching remains lexical and does not independently resolve word-sense/polysemy
B1 nuisance invariance is not general semantic abstraction
query utility is not truth or independent evaluation
a V2 pass is B2 evidence only when the prefrozen B1 gate passes
